<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Restaurant"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction" name="Buzzer and instruction"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Restaurant" name="Restaurant" processRef="Process_Restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Places order" sourceRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerInstruction" name="Passes buzzer and gives instruction" sourceRef="Task_EmployeePassBuzzer" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Event_GuestBuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" name="Appears at service hatch" sourceRef="Task_GuestAppearAtHatch" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Hands over meal" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveMeal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_GuestHungry" name="Feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestEnterRestaurant" name="Enter the restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestWaitTurn" name="Wait until it is his turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" name="Place order with employee" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instruction" messageRef="Message_BuzzerAndInstruction"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GuestBuzzerRings" name="Buzzer rings">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_GuestBuzzerRings" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRings"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestGoToHatch" name="Go to the service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestAppearAtHatch" name="Appear at the service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestReceiveMeal" name="Receive meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestEatMeal" name="Eat the meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_GuestFinished" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_GuestEnterRestaurant"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_2" sourceRef="Task_GuestEnterRestaurant" targetRef="Task_GuestChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_3" sourceRef="Task_GuestChooseDish" targetRef="Task_GuestWaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_4" sourceRef="Task_GuestWaitTurn" targetRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_5" sourceRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_6" sourceRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Event_GuestBuzzerRings"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_7" sourceRef="Event_GuestBuzzerRings" targetRef="Task_GuestGoToHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_8" sourceRef="Task_GuestGoToHatch" targetRef="Task_GuestAppearAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_9" sourceRef="Task_GuestAppearAtHatch" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_10" sourceRef="Task_GuestReceiveMeal" targetRef="Task_GuestEatMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_11" sourceRef="Task_GuestEatMeal" targetRef="EndEvent_GuestFinished"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Restaurant" name="Restaurant meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Restaurant">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employee" name="Employee">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Restaurant</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeEnterOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeCollectMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeePassBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeInformChef</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_FiveMinuteTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeCallGuest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_MealHandedOver</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Chef" name="Chef">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChefPrepareMeal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChefPlaceMealInHatch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChefInformEmployee</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Restaurant" name="Order process begins"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder" name="Receive guest's order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EmployeeEnterOrder" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeCollectMoney" name="Collect money from guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeePassBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer and pass it to guest with instruction"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeInformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefPrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefPlaceMealInHatch" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefInformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is ready in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer" name="Wait for guest or five minutes" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest" name="Receive guest at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_FiveMinuteTimer" name="Five minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_FiveMinutes">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" name="Call for guest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MealHandedOver" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Restaurant" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_2" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_EmployeeEnterOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_3" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeEnterOrder" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCollectMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_4" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCollectMoney" targetRef="Task_EmployeePassBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_5" sourceRef="Task_EmployeePassBuzzer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_6" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef" targetRef="Task_ChefPrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_7" sourceRef="Task_ChefPrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_ChefPlaceMealInHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_8" sourceRef="Task_ChefPlaceMealInHatch" targetRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_9" sourceRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee" targetRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_10" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_11" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_12" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer" targetRef="Event_FiveMinuteTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_13" sourceRef="Event_FiveMinuteTimer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_14" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForGuestOrTimer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_15" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest" targetRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restaurant_16" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" targetRef="EndEvent_MealHandedOver"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
